name: Refractive Glass
description: Organic, uneven radii, hairline borders, refractive glass surfaces, comfortable density, high elevation, fluid motion, and an iridescent sheen.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's refractive recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, the state transforms are none and motion is instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: Translucent surfaces with a backdrop blur cost paint time on slower devices, and read less clearly over busy content.
A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.

tokens.surface-material: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 14%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-information) 10%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-default) 70%, transparent))
tokens.texture: linear-gradient(120deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 18%, transparent), transparent 32%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-information) 16%, transparent) 68%, transparent)
